title: Cascade-Correlation Growth Walkthrough
summary: Step through candidate training, installation, and freezing on a tiny constructive network.
learning_goals: Distinguish output-weight training from candidate-unit training.
See why the selected hidden unit is frozen after installation.
Connect residual correlation to incremental network growth.

title: Residual Correlation Playground
summary: Move a candidate unit's weights and see how its activation pattern correlates with residual error on a toy XOR problem.
learning_goals: Understand why Cascade-Correlation trains candidate units against residual error.
See why absolute correlation magnitude matters more than sign.
Connect a candidate hidden unit's activation pattern to a growth decision.

title: Constructive Algorithm Taxonomy
summary: Explore constructive-algorithm processes: when to modify structure, what to modify, and how to choose new parameters.
learning_goals: Separate construction, pruning, and merging as structural operations.
Distinguish global and local performance signals as growth triggers.
Understand STDC as construction whose control or parameters depend on spike times.
